project_guidance.title: Scottish ancillary building checks
project_guidance.intro: Use this starting point with the full official guidance and the planning history for your address.
rules: Ancillary buildings must not become a separate home.
Check rear siting and coverage, the 4m overall height and 3m eaves limits, and the 2.5m limit within 1m of a boundary.
Listed-building grounds and conservation areas have smaller footprint allowances; read the full conditions.
